test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A sum was lent for one year at the rate of 16 percent per annum on compound interest (compounding annually). If the compounding had been done half yearly, then the interest would have increased by Rs. 64. What was the sum lent?
solution:
**Given:**

Interest rate (r) = 16% or 0.16

Time (t) = 1 year

Interest increase = Rs 64

**Formula used:**

Compound interest annually: A = P(1 + r) = P(1 + 0.16)

Compound interest semi-annually: A = P(1 + r/2)²

**Calculation:**

⇒ P(1 + 0.08)2

⇒ 1.16P = 1.1664P + 64 0.0064P

⇒ 64 P = 64/0.0064 P = 10,000

**The sum lent was Rs 10,000.**
